alt: Pacinian (lamellated) corpuscle - an encapsulated mechanoreceptor deep in the dermis + subcutaneous tissue. Detects vibration + deep pressure. Onion-like concentric lamellae of connective tissue surround the unmyelinated nerve ending. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
